svg.title: LLR 4LIFE — Animated Iowa City and Country license plate inspired display art
svg.desc: An animated decorative Iowa-style plate with recognizable blue city-and-country skyline, white wind turbine and farm buildings, white IOWA header, black LLR 4LIFE lettering, green grass county strip reading WEBSTER, neon edging, and glowing star-like glitter. Decorative artwork, not a valid registration plate.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans Narrow,DejaVu Sans Condensed,Arial Narrow,sans-serif
